cases.expected: frontend build succeeds with a supported module resolution mode
cases.expected_fix: use Bundler or another supported resolution mode

cases.expected: dependency review passes with a non-vulnerable pytest release
cases.expected_fix: upgrade to a non-vulnerable release and re-run dependency review

cases.symptom: npm ci requires an existing package-lock.json
cases.root_cause: workflow assumed lockfile that repository did not contain
cases.expected: Pages dependency installation succeeds using the repository's actual lockfile policy
cases.expected_fix: either commit a lockfile and use npm ci or use npm install until lockfile adoption

cases.symptom: static GitHub Pages dashboard receives 404 for /api/*
cases.root_cause: GitHub Pages hosts static assets only
cases.expected: Pages runs in explicit read-only demo mode or targets a separately deployed API
cases.expected_fix: explicit read-only demo mode or configure a separately deployed API base URL
